approach: Static recompilation of the retail XBE to C++; XDK HLE with a Direct3D 12 renderer and XAudio2 on Windows, and a native Vulkan renderer with SDL3 on Linux (no Wine)
help: Fix D2: the loaded household renders correctly into the host Vulkan target but presents black - localised in docs/playtest.md (1912 draws to target 0283C000, target BMPs show the scene, guest-size dump reads 0.0); prime suspect is image layout/DCC visibility in VulkanBackend::PrepareBlitSource on RADV
Fix D3: 159-267 nopipeline dropped draws per frame in the household, with some Sims as black silhouettes in an otherwise correct target
Play visible gameplay once D2 lands: motives/HUD, walking, camera, per-call frame-rate consumers at high fps, saving and reloading through play
Exercise a real controller: no gamepad has ever been plugged into the test machine, so the SDL gamepad path is unexercised
Hor+ ultrawide on the Vulkan backend: today the picture is pillarboxed at the title's own 4:3, and widening every viewport/scissor/2-D placement by the offset is its own piece of work
Build and test the Windows target (Direct3D 12 + XAudio2): it has never been compiled, as the development machine has no MSVC or Windows SDK

Name the remaining genuinely unmatched XDK names in config/game.toml (7 crt_* math entries; the other 41 names at 0 are for sections this XBE does not have) and the graded D3D candidates in docs/d3d-gap-functions.md
notes: In progress: the native Linux build (Vulkan + SDL3, no Wine) boots and drives title, main menu, save select, name entry and Create-a-Sim on screen, saves a Sim, and loads a household at 2076-2178 draws/frame (docs/playtest.md) - but that household renders into the host target yet presents pure black (open defect D2, localised to the draw-to-blit path), and 159-267 draws/frame are dropped as nopipeline (D3). Game speed is measured at 1.000 game-seconds per real second at fps_cap 60, 144 and uncapped (SIMSBO_NO_STEP controls 1.112, 2.400, ~23.3). F1/F2 panels apply settings live, keyboard-as-pad is screenshot-proven, and Give Money was entered through the game's own setter (cheat mask 02). The retail USA XBE (title id 0x45410043, built 2003-11-13, XDK 5558) recompiles to 27,492 functions; config/game.toml names 194 of 242 symbols and 12 of 12 data symbols. Unproven: visible household gameplay, saving/reloading through play, Hor+ ultrawide (pillarboxed at the title's own 4:3 today), and any real gamepad - no controller has ever been plugged into the test machine. The Windows target (Direct3D 12 + XAudio2) has never been compiled: the development machine has no MSVC or Windows SDK, so all _WIN32 paths are untested.
